title: Diptych with Football and Warplanes
description: Two framed collages hang side by side on a grey marbled wall. Left panel features an American football, bullseye targets, compact discs, and red vertical stripes on a white ground; right panel shows warplane silhouettes, compact discs, yellow vertical stripes, and a target on a pale crumpled ground.
composition: two framed works hung side by side
